title: Aromatic Tender Japanese Chicken Wrap
description: A peppery and tender Japanese dish featuring chicken, almonds, and ssam wrap, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is high in protein and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, toast the sliced almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the cooked chicken into thin strips and placing it onto the ssam wrap along with toasted almonds, green onions, and a sprinkle of black pepper.
